scripts.build: npm run verify:reproducible && npm run build --workspaces --if-present && npm run smoke:dist
scripts.smoke:dist: node shared/dist/index.js && node adapter/dist/index.js && node desktop/dist/index.js && npm run smoke:file -w @uclaw/frontend
scripts.test: npm run verify:reproducible && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs tests/packaging/*.test.mjs && npm run test:contract && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:activation-server: cd activation-server && go test -p=1 -count=1 ./... && go test -p=1 -race -count=1 ./... && go vet ./... && CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -trimpath -o /dev/null ./cmd/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run verify:reproducible && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
